references.text: Describes the community's role as a protector of the manslayer against the avenger of blood until he stands trial.
Introduces the concept of the 'avenger of blood' (גֹּאֵל הַדָּם) whom the community is to judge between.
The continuation of the text describing the community's judicial decision and the rescue of the manslayer.
Parallel legislation concerning the avenger of blood and protection for one who has killed unintentionally.
The elders of the city shall judge and hand over the manslayer to the avenger of blood if it was intentional murder.
Practical application of the law where the one seeking refuge must explain their case before the elders at the city gate.
Fundamental law regarding cities of refuge for one who kills unintentionally.
